about: Zones each business needs, with the size rules the layout checker tests against measured Matterport rooms. Severity: 'legal' = set by a cited code or licensing rule; 'functional' = the business cannot operate without it (sizes are planning rules, labelled as such); 'advisory' = good practice, reported but never blocking. Only legal and functional failures count as conflicts.

cafe.label: Dining / seating area
cafe.why: Seats need 15 sq ft of dining floor each.

cafe.label: Prep & dish area
cafe.why: Espresso, prep sink and dishwashing need a back area; ~15% of the dining area, at least 80 sq ft, with a 6 ft clear width for a counter line plus aisle.

cafe.label: Accessible restroom
cafe.why: Food service needs a customer restroom; an accessible single-user room needs a 5 ft (60 in) turning space.

restaurant.label: Dining room
restaurant.why: Seats need 15 sq ft of dining floor each.

restaurant.label: Kitchen
restaurant.why: A full kitchen is commonly 30–40% of the dining area (35% used here, at least 200 sq ft) and needs ~8 ft clear for a cook line plus a 42 in aisle.

restaurant.label: Accessible restroom
restaurant.why: Restaurants this size usually need two restrooms; each accessible single-user room needs a 5 ft turning space. Exact count depends on the plumbing code's occupant load.

gym.label: Workout floor
gym.why: 50 sq ft per person exercising; 9 ft+ ceilings suit overhead lifts and jump work.

gym.label: Lockers & restroom
gym.why: Members need a restroom and changing area; accessible rooms need a 5 ft turning space.

clinic.label: Exam room
clinic.why: One exam room per 3 people inside at once; each ~100 sq ft and 8 ft wide fits a table, a clinician and a chair. Some states apply FGI outpatient guidelines — confirm locally.

clinic.label: Accessible restroom
clinic.why: Patients need an accessible restroom with a 5 ft turning space.

clinic.label: Office / lab
clinic.why: Charting, supplies and a small lab.

daycare.label: Classrooms / activity space
daycare.why: State licensing sets indoor activity space per child, excluding bathrooms, halls, offices and kitchen.

daycare.label: Children's restroom
daycare.why: About one restroom per 15 children (planning rule — confirm the licensing count); each accessible room needs a 5 ft turning space.

daycare.label: Kitchen / food prep
daycare.why: Meals and snacks need a prep area.

daycare.label: Office & sick-child area
daycare.why: Director's office and an isolation area.

daycare.label: Outdoor play area
daycare.why: State licensing requires outdoor play space per child. An interior scan cannot verify it — check the lot and the aerial view.
